verses.text: Jacob kept moving, and God’s angels met him along the way. 👼
When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s camp!” He named the place Mahanaim. ✨
Jacob sent messengers ahead to his brother Esau, in Seir—the region of Edom. 🧭
He told them, “Here’s what you’ll say to my lord Esau: ‘Your servant Jacob says, “I’ve been living as a foreigner with Laban and stayed there until now. 💬
I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male and female servants. I sent word to my lord, hoping to find favor with you.’” 🐑
The messengers came back to Jacob: “We went to your brother Esau. He’s on his way to meet you—with 400 men.” 📣
Jacob was terrified, with no small amount of distress. He split his people, flocks, herds, and camels into two camps. 😨
He thought, “If Esau attacks one camp, maybe the other can get away.” ⚠️
Jacob prayed, “God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac—Yahweh, You told me, ‘Go back to your country and relatives, and I’ll do you good.’ 🙏
I don’t deserve all the kindness and faithfulness You’ve shown Your servant. I crossed this Jordan with just my staff, and now my people and animals fill two camps. 🥹
Please rescue me from my brother Esau. I’m scared he’ll come after me—and the mothers with their children. 🙏
You promised, ‘I’ll do you good and make your descendants as countless as the sand of the sea.’” 🌊
Jacob stayed there that night and chose a gift for his brother Esau from what he had: 🎁
200 female goats and 20 male goats, 200 ewes and 20 rams, 🐐
30 nursing camels with their young, 40 cows, 10 bulls, 20 female donkeys, and 10 foals. 🐪
He handed each herd to its own servant and said, “Go ahead of me, with space between each group.” 🐑
He coached the servant at the front: “When Esau meets you and asks, ‘Who do you belong to? Where are you headed? Whose animals are these up ahead?’ 💬
Tell him, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They’re a gift for my lord Esau. Look, Jacob is coming behind us too.’” 🎁
He gave the same instructions to the second servant, the third, and everyone bringing the herds: “Say this to Esau when you meet him. 🗣️
Tell him, ‘Your servant Jacob is coming behind us too.’” Jacob thought, “Maybe this gift ahead of me will calm Esau down; then I can face him. Maybe he’ll welcome me.” 🤝
So the gift went ahead of him, while Jacob stayed in camp that night. 🌙
That night Jacob got up, took his two wives, his two female servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok. 🌙
He sent them across the stream and sent across everything else he had. 🌊
Jacob was left alone. Then a man wrestled with him through the night, all the way to dawn. 🌌
When the man couldn’t overpower Jacob, he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh. The thigh was strained as they wrestled. ⚠️
The man said, “Let me go—the day is breaking.” Jacob answered, “I’m not letting go unless you bless me.” 🌅
The man asked, “What’s your name?” He answered, “Jacob.” 🗣️
He said, “Your name won’t be Jacob anymore; it’ll be Israel, because you’ve struggled with God and people—and prevailed.” ✨
Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He replied, “Why are you asking my name?” Then he blessed Jacob right there. 🙏
Jacob named that place Peniel, saying, “I saw God face to face, and somehow my life was spared.” 😳
The sun came up as Jacob passed Peniel. He was limping because of his thigh. 🌅
That’s why the children of Israel still don’t eat the hip tendon inside the thigh: the man had touched the tendon in Jacob’s thigh. 📜
